purpose: Local end-to-end video-memory smoke evaluation, not a general accuracy benchmark

questions.question: What animals were visible behind the person?
questions.criterion: Names elephants and cites a frame.

questions.question: What separated the person from the animals?
questions.criterion: Describes the visible enclosure barrier and cites a frame.

questions.question: What colors were visible on the person's jacket?
questions.criterion: Mentions the clearly visible red, gray and black portions; cites a frame.

questions.question: What did the speaker say was notable about the animals?
questions.criterion: Recalls the comment about long trunks and cites transcribed audio.

questions.question: Where did the person leave their keys?
questions.criterion: Does not invent an object location; states there is no supporting evidence.

questions.question: What time did the speaker arrive at the zoo?
questions.criterion: States arrival time is not established; does not confuse recording/import time with arrival time.
